record.paper: Hitting all maximum stable sets in $P_5$-free graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Hitting all maximum stable sets in $P_5$-free graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every integer $t\geq 6$, the class of $P_{t}$-free graphs is $\eta$-bounded.
dossier_meta.context_text: After proving $\eta$-boundedness for $P_5$-free graphs (Theorem 1.12), the authors note that it remains open whether $P_t$-free graphs are $\eta$-bounded for $t\geq 6$, and state this as a conjecture paralleling the known $\chi$-boundedness of $P_t$-free graphs for all $t$.
